We weren't carrying anything illegal, the freighter was ''insured''--and Noggox told me ''exactly'' what to do if we were raided by pirates. Transmit an emergency distress signal to Coruscant!|A Lieutenant to the captain|<ref name="Strange Allies" />}}
A '''''Consular''-class''' [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was owned by [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Description==
A [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was used as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] by [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was painted [[Color/Legends|silver]], featured [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. It had at least one [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. A [[Hologram/Legends|Hologram]] emitter was on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="Strange Allies" /> Like other [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of its class, it was 115 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and had three sub light [[Dyne 577 radial atomizer engine]] units.<ref name="CCS" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' states that the early parts of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' take place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions|Secret Missions]]'' series takes place just after those episodes.</ref> the freighter was carrying [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] to the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Unidentified Klatooinian captain|man]], and other crew included a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Unidentified Snivvian lieutenant|lieutenant]], a [[Unidentified Rodian (Noggox's freighter)|Rodian]], another [[Unidentified six-armed alien (freighter)|alien]], and a [[Unidentified Human (Noggox's freighter)|Human]]. The freighter was intercepted near [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] by [[Dool Pundar]]'s [[Profit (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|pirate ship]], which disabled the two of the freighter's thrusters and the primary shield generator. Pundar ordered the crew to surrender and sent [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s to take control of the vessel. Pundar then allowed the crew to leave in an escape pod. After Pundar absconded with their vessel, the crew transmitted a distress signal to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], home of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At the time of its capture, the ship was insured.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The freighter appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' young readers series.
